title: Increase lead generation and tracking consistency on landing pages
body:
Standardized lead generation and tracking across all relevant landing pages without altering the design.

### Changes:
1. **Tracking Infrastructure**: 
   - Modified `hooks/useLeadCapture.ts` to allow an optional `formType` parameter in `submitLead` and `pushGenerateLeadDataLayerEvent`.
   - Standardized the `form_submission` event in the Data Layer to allow granular categorization (e.g., `event_lead` for QR code campaigns).

2. **CTA Consistency & Event Tagging**:
   - Audited all landing pages (`BrazilPromotionDay`, `ConsultoriaDeViagem`, `ViagensParaExecutivos`, `CuradoriaCruzeirosBrasil`, `Lollapalooza`, `Orlando`, `BetoCarrero`, `MelhorIdade`).
   - Added `.btn-whatsapp` and `.btn-specialist` classes to all primary conversion buttons. This ensures the existing `utm-tracking.js` script correctly captures `whatsapp_cta_click` and `specialist_cta_click` events with full metadata.
   - Added a "Falar com especialista" CTA to the bottom of the Lollapalooza landing page for consistency with other pages.

3. **UTM Preservation**:
   - Verified that all direct WhatsApp links use the `useWhatsAppLink` hook with `appendTrackingRef: true`.
   - Confirmed that lead capture forms correctly include marketing parameters stored in `sessionStorage`.

4. **Constraint Compliance**:
   - Reverted design changes (colors/fonts) in the Lollapalooza landing page following code review to strictly adhere to the "no design changes" rule.

### Checklist:
- [x] UTMs preservadas
- [x] Eventos de CTA funcionando (whatsapp_cta_click, specialist_cta_click, form_submission)
- [x] Build ok (pnpm build and typecheck passed)
- [x] Regression tests passed (pnpm test:regression)
- [x] E2E verification of new form_type passed (tests/e2e/brazil-promotion-day.spec.ts)
